content: The purpose of this section is to provide a concise explanation of the overarching vision of the project. This is where you would succinctly address the fundamental questions of the project: Who is involved? What is the project about? Where will it take place? When will it occur? Why is it being undertaken? To begin your overview, you may use the following template as a starting point, which can be modified and expanded as necessary: The purpose of the (project name) project is to ________. This project is designed for (select all applicable: college students, medical students, interns, residents, attending physicians, hospitalists, specialists, medical faculty, researchers, nurses, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, and allied health professionals) to contribute their expertise. This project will require participants to achieve proficiency in (insert relevant statement here). WikiDoc welcomes your involvement in contributing to this project. Goals of the (project name) project: Goal one Goal two Goal three Who can contribute to the (project name) project? This section should include a brief statement about the intended specialty or group of individuals this project is designed for. Additionally, please specify whether this is an Assistant, Associate, or Editor-in-Chief level project. For example: This project is intended for editors at an Assistant Editor-in-Chief level or higher. This may be the right project for you if you are a (select all applicable: college student, medical student, intern, resident, attending physician, hospitalist, specialist, medical faculty, researcher, nurse, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, or allied health professional). How to get started: Select a topic This section provides a basic framework for initiating a sortable project. Further discussion can be tailored to the specific needs of each project. For example: The above includes a list of topics for this project ranked by priority. To claim a topic, email WikiDoc with the name of the project you are selecting. Active assignments can be viewed here. Please ensure the link is updated to the appropriate page (if applicable) or remove this line. Feel free to expand this section as needed. Next Steps This section should include a numbered list of steps outlining how to proceed through the process. This allows contributors to follow a structured pathway. Additionally, this is where you would include examples and any project-specific help instructions.
